extracted.name: Dill Sauce
extracted.description: Looking for dill sauce for salmon, or your favorite fish or seafood? This sour cream version is the perfect, easy, fresh accompaniment to offer.
instruction_lines: Whisk together sour cream, mustard, lemon juice, and dill until well blended. Chill before serving.
